narr: Storms developed along a weak surface boundary within a moisture-rich environment with weak mean-layer flow. Slow moving storms produced rainfall rates of 3 to 4 inches per hour, with amounts of 3.09 inches reported by a cooperative weather observer near Wakefield and personal automated gauges and radar estimates up to 4 inches over portions of the Sioux City metro area.
ev: A car was stalled in flood waters along South Ridge Drive near U.S. Highway 77.
lsr: S Ridge Dr near Hwy 77 flooded with car stalled. Via social media.
